text:
Jin: Orion cloud reached out for a co-marketing push: marketplace listing + short benchmark blog + joint webinar. Need owners and a lean ops plan.

Rory: I can own the marketplace listing and partner liaison. Need logos, hero (1200x600), 60s demo, 2-sentence blurb. Orion asked for a launch window the week of Jul 12.

Eve (Orion): We can provide logos and a co-branded hero by Jul 1. We can promote the webinar in our partner newsletter. Happy to record the 60s clip if you share script.

Maya: I'll draft the benchmark blog. Plan: transparent methodology + two small charts (latency & cost delta) comparing baseline vs Redwood with caching and Redwood+Orion edge. Will need perf runs and sample prompt set.

ops-bot: Marketplace readiness checklist posted in #ops-templates: assets, 60s video, legal signoff, UTM tags.

Design: Can do hero + social cards and edit a 60s clip. Need final headline and 3 bullets by Fri.

Jin: Two priority asks: (1) AE one-pager (top objections + rebuttals), (2) lead routing mapping so ops can auto-tag marketplace leads.

Rory: Proposed routing snippet for ops:

```
source=partner_marketplace
partner=orion_cloud
campaign=orion_co_launch_jul2026
sfdc_owner=Partner_Ops
lead_queue=partners_orion
utm_source=orion_marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=orion_co_launch_jul2026
```

Maya: On benchmarks 3: will run three scenarios: baseline, Redwood caching, Redwood+Orion edge routing. If we see >=2x improvement on regional latency, we'll call it out with methodology. Posting numbers Tue.

Eve (Orion): Orion will provide a short customer quote and can amplify via our newsletter, pending legal sign-off.

Jin: Action owners:
- Rory: marketplace listing + metadata (owner)
- Maya: benchmark blog + methodology (owner)
- Design: hero + social + video edit (owner)
- Eve (Orion): partner assets + newsletter promo (partner)
- Jin: AE one-pager + legal loop (owner)

Jin: Post blockers here. If none, we'll lock a date and spin up a timeline doc. :rocket:
